thesis: The episode discusses how Raul Vora, founder of Superhuman, applied game design principles and onboarding psychology to build a productivity app that developed a cult following in Silicon Valley. It details his background as a game designer and game developer, his early realization that he wanted to be a founder, and his approach of refining the product manually and charging premium pricing from day one rather than chasing immediate growth.
